title: Persisted layer breaker rows
summary: The Host-owned JSON file at <data_root>/luc/breaker.json. One row per nonempty module id, keyed to an exact layered hash; malformed input must not trip unrelated modules.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: read

input.description: At most 256 KiB of JSON file bytes, or missing/unreadable input.

operations.notes: No deadline. Missing, unreadable, oversized, malformed or non-object file becomes empty rows. Invalid individual rows are omitted; valid sibling rows remain. Readers derive tripped from breaks >= 3.

operations.name: write
operations.notes: No deadline. Serialized across processes via directory flock; writes sorted compact UTF-8 JSON, fsyncs the temporary file and replaces the target.

invariants.text: A row trips only when both id and resolved_hash match the queried layer version.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Verified by unit and cross-process tests in test_luc_modules.py.
